title: Monday Quick Tip
subtitle: When parents compare
hook: A parent asks why another kid gets more time than theirs.
intro: Both kids are on your team.
statement: Every child deserves to be talked about on their own.
q1: Do you talk only about their child's progress —
q3: What does their child need to work on?
t1: Both can work. But conversations stay fair
t2: when each kid is discussed on their own.
cta: Coaches — how do you handle comparisons?
ctaLines: Talk about their child only. Explain once. Redirect.
Focus on their child or explain the difference?
ctaPrompt: Share your parent habit below. There are no wrong answers.
caption:
A parent asks why another kid gets more time than theirs.
They are comparing two players. Both kids are on your team.
Every child deserves to be talked about on their own.
Talk only about their child or explain the difference. There is no single right way.
How do you handle comparisons? Share your habit in the comments.
